name: Surface Battery
author: James
description: Battery indicator for Surface devices whose battery is not exposed via /sys/class/power_supply. Reads the Surface Aggregator Module directly through /run/surface-battery/state.json, written by surface-battery-poller.service.

barWidget.description: Battery level read straight from the Surface Aggregator Module. Use on machines where UPower reports no battery.

schema.label: Show percentage
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the icon. The button widens to fit it.

schema.label: Horizontal padding
schema.description: Extra pixels of space on each side of the icon.
